meta.name: ast-grep
meta.description: Use ast-grep (sg) for AST-aware code search and rewrite across 25 languages. Trigger for structural code matching or deterministic codemods: find every function/call/class/import shaped like X, rewrite console.log to logger.info, strip `as any`, migrate require() to import, find empty catch blocks or missing await, and scan/apply YAML rules. Prefer this over rg/grep when the target is syntax shape rather than text; use rg for string contents, comments, filenames, or regex-style byte searches.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按代码结构搜索并批量改写代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要跨文件修改同一类代码结构。
copy.tagline_en: Search code by syntax shape and rewrite it in bulk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to modify the same kind of code structure across files.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按代码结构(而非文本)查找和改写代码:支持 25 种语言,能找形状相同的函数/调用/导入,批量替换写法(如 console.log 改为 logger.info),并运行 YAML 规则。改写前会先预览。
howto.when: 当用户要求按代码结构查找或改写(如“找所有 X”“把 Y 改成 Z”、运行规则扫描)时触发;若目标是文本(字符串、注释、文件名)则不触发。

say.text: 找到所有接收 Request 参数的函数。
say.note: Claude 会按结构匹配搜索并列出结果。

say.text: 把所有 console.log(x) 改成 logger.info(x)。
say.note: Claude 会先预览改动,经你确认后再应用。

say.text: 扫描 src 目录,运行规则文件检查违例。
say.note: Claude 会运行 scan 并汇总报告。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses ast-grep for AST-aware search and rewrite across 25 languages. It matches code shape, rewrites patterns (e.g., console.log to logger.info), and runs YAML rules. It validates first and previews before applying.
howto.when_en: Triggers for structural code lookup or rewrite (e.g., find functions like X, replace console.log with logger.info) or running lint rules. Not for text searches (string contents, comments, filenames).

say_en.text: Find every function that takes a Request parameter.
say_en.note: Claude will search structurally and list the results.

say_en.text: Scan src and run the rule files for violations.
say_en.note: Claude will run scan and report issues.
